SELECT T1.name FROM Highschooler AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.highschooler_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING count(*)  >=  3
SELECT customer_id ,  first_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM credit_cards)
SELECT date_added FROM customers WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 10 AND 20
SELECT document_id FROM Documents WHERE budget_description  =  'Government'
SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM teachers AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id  =  T2.teacher_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.driver_id ,  T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN laptimes AS T2 ON T1.driver_id  =  T2.driver_id WHERE T2.milliseconds  >  100000
SELECT T1.part_name ,  COUNT(*) FROM Parts AS T1 JOIN Assets AS T2 ON T1.part_id  =  T2.part_id GROUP BY T1.part_id
SELECT T1.name FROM film_studio AS T1 JOIN film AS T2 ON T1.studio_id  =  T2.studio_id GROUP BY T1.studio_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT college) FROM player WHERE team  =  'Columbus Crew'
SELECT T1.mountain_id ,  T1.name FROM mountains AS T1 JOIN mountain_photos AS T2 ON T1.mountain_id  =  T2.mountain_id GROUP BY T1.mountain_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2
SELECT count(*) FROM Student_Allergies WHERE Allergy  =  "Cat"
SELECT count(*) FROM country WHERE language != 'English'
SELECT air_date FROM episodes WHERE title = "A Love of a Lifetime"
SELECT Allergy_Type ,  COUNT(*) FROM Allergy_Students GROUP BY Allergy_Type
SELECT count(*) FROM budget_codes

SELECT T1.name FROM swimmer AS T1 JOIN record AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.swimmer_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING count(*)  >=  2
